summary:
Confirmed HEAD f6c3e20c10203a9b7fde0f52eb38af8ca630dcdb. The requested process redesign remains warranted. T746 records the owner's adopted requirements-led Guide design, rather than an inferred preference (spec/tasks/done/T746.land-guide-redesign-and-requirements-led-post-guide.md:15). POST-122 requires retained question screens and explicit Next; POST-123 requires a summary with routes to original inputs; POST-124 keeps relevant requirements visible while material is gathered (spec/ssot/POST.md:93,99,235).

| Journey | Current → coherent target | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| New/from-post entry | New explicitly mints title/template; from-post imports videos and seeds owner material → retain both commitments, explain that a draft is being prepared, and converge on the same preparation workspace without re-entering inherited material. | ClipPage.tsx:18; ClipProjectForm.tsx:258; pages/editor/model/createClipFromPost.ts:39 |
| Material and source post | Title/template, answers, instruction, campaign, link and styles precede the source picker → put advertiser context and linked-post provenance before footage selection, then gather/order footage and retain source-audio choices. | ClipProjectForm.tsx:295,384,427,436,453,592; ClipWorkspace.tsx:211 |
| Ordinary/narrated intent | Dubbing is a checkbox below appearance controls → make the intended output and confirmed voice understandable before approval, distinguishing narration from independently retained original sound. | ClipProjectForm.tsx:588; ClipVoiceChoice.tsx:35; CLIP.md:209 |
| Model/template/style choices | Optional template is a listbox; renderer-drawn style samples already exist; models appear at the bottom → organize these by their effect on the result, preserve their existing eligibility/samples, and read their current choices back on review. | ClipProjectForm.tsx:319; ClipDesignSelection.tsx:143; ClipWorkspace.tsx:226 |
| Preparation/review | Four progress segments scroll a long form; there is no pre-run summary → retained preparation screens, truthful current position, Back/Next, and a final summary with one named change route per input. | ClipWorkspace.tsx:835; pages/editor/ui/EditorGuide.tsx:74; EditorReview.tsx:60 |
| Storyline/build | Storyline review occupies 수정 before a plan exists; rebuild/build actions share its disclosure heading → a clearly named review checkpoint with scene/body editing, optional revision, and one docked build action retaining its separate approval. | ClipWorkspace.tsx:349,629; ClipStorylineSpace.tsx:89; ClipGenerationActions.tsx:65 |
| Focused editing | Preview, timeline, contextual tools and script/storyline sheets already exist → preserve that useful editing model and align its action bar with the adopted shared step bar. | ClipWorkspace.tsx:428,570,598; ClipCorrectionWorkspace.tsx:401,721; shared/ui/step-bar/StepBar.tsx:8 |
| Render/export/finalize | Eligible render choice, revision-labelled old result, download and explicit finalization already exist → make current draft, delivered render and confirmed completion a clear sequence, retaining finalization consequences and independently approved upload text. | ClipWorkspace.tsx:498,550,672; ClipRenderAction.tsx:38; FinalizeClipAction.tsx:24; ClipUploadText.tsx:109 |
| Resume/loading/failure | Persisted artifacts select the lifecycle; running jobs restore focused progress; preparation's cursor initially says Sources → preserve artifact-derived entry, retain the preparation cursor within the workspace, and later specify prepared-draft resume after source readiness resolves. Never infer completion from a render alone. | widgets/clip-workspace/model/steps.ts:20; useClipWorkspace.ts:54,128; ClipWorkspace.tsx:91,744 |

All frontend paths above are under frontend/src/. The target retains the existing three lifecycle stages; preparation and storyline review are subordinate screens, not new persisted lifecycle states.

Recommended sequence of independently reviewed slices: (1) preparation screens and review, detailed below; (2) explicit ordinary/narrated choices and clearer new-entry/template selection using existing voice and visual samples; (3) storyline review-to-build checkpoint; (4) preview-editor step bar; (5) completion/render status and fact-based resume polish. Estimate later slices at 30–75 minutes each before publication gates, subject to their own scoped inspection. Each must amend its affected SSOT policy before coding. Do not call slice 1 the completed whole-flow redesign.

T753–T756, the return-filter repair and T757 are completed exclusions (spec/reports/261112-ui12.md:5). Earlier video findings concern retention or converted failures, not this process proposal (spec/review/video-request-retention-261112.md:13; spec/review/clip-failure-visibility-260914.md:9). INSTACLIP.md is absent in this snapshot; CLIP-209/211 govern both channels. VIDEO governs post attachments, whose transport and limits remain unchanged (spec/ssot/VIDEO.md:2). No tests, browser sessions, generation or runtime mutations were performed by this scout.

proposals.title: Recommended first slice: turn preparation into retained screens ending in a review
proposals.problem: The preparation UI presents a navigation sequence that its content does not follow. Sources is the initial selected segment, but title, template, answers, instruction, advertiser guide, linked post, duration, design and dubbing render before the source picker. Selecting a segment only updates a label and scrolls; scrolling otherwise does not update that selection. Generation remains available from the long form without a review of the material and settings being supplied. This creates a process-level mismatch with the adopted blog workflow, affecting new projects after minting, imported projects and returning owners in both channels.
proposals.evidence: Observed source: ClipProjectForm.tsx:295 begins with title/template; :384 begins answers/instruction; :427 renders campaign material after instruction; :436 renders the linked post; :453 begins style; :588 renders dubbing; :592 finally inserts children. Those children contain the source picker at ClipWorkspace.tsx:211 and models at :226. ClipWorkspace.tsx:843 changes guide state and calls scrollIntoView; :855 conditionally selects only the lifecycle panel. By comparison, EditorGuide.tsx:85 retains every StepScreen while hidden, :102 uses StepBar, and :120 retains the summary's action component. EditorReview.tsx:150 gives each summary row its own labelled change control. The shared primitives already supply heading focus, position semantics and semantic tokens (StepScreen.tsx:37; GuideProgress.tsx:63; StepBar.tsx:33). Existing safety logic is substantial: ClipProjectForm.tsx:110 restores queued drafts, :168 keeps fields usable during autosave, and ClipWorkspace.tsx:191 flushes before generation. T757's retained request is already at ClipWorkspace.tsx:109 and must stay there. Inference: ordering the work into retained preparation screens and reviewing it before approval should reduce searching and uncertainty; no task-time improvement has been measured. Unknowns: current real-browser geometry, field-return focus under a software keyboard, and the exact number of affected test adaptations require implementation-stage measurement. The older wrapping/pointer observations are recorded at .git/haeram/v1/launchers/ui12/video2-next-observation.json:6,8; they are subsidiary acceptance observations, not this proposal's rationale.
proposals.change:
Causal hypothesis: the main preparation cost comes from presenting all inputs simultaneously, in an order different from the guide, without a readable checkpoint before committing. Replace the scroll-only guide with four actual retained panels: 소스 → 이야기 → 스타일 → 확인. 소스 asks what material the video uses: advertiser context, the existing linked-post control and import feedback, then the existing footage picker/order/audio/binding controls. 이야기 contains the current title, optional template, its answers and owner instruction. 스타일 contains existing duration, fixed ratio, narration/confirmed-voice and appearance controls. 확인 summarizes the latest local draft, selected material, linked post, campaign context, template, instruction, duration, narration/voice and visual choices; each read-only row has one named 바꾸기 route to its original panel. Keep the existing model selectors and eligibility explanation on 확인, rather than inventing model recommendations or another options system. Show narration-off explicitly in the summary without implying original audio is off.

Use existing StepScreen, GuideProgress, StepBar, StepBarActions and StepBarBack. Keep fields, uploads and generation-action components mounted across preparation navigation. Keep their queues and mutation/approval ownership unchanged. Assemble sibling features through widget-owned slots; do not make edit-clip-project import upload or speech features. One step bar shows Back/Next on the first three panels and the existing separately quoted 스토리라인 먼저 / 바로 만들기 actions on 확인, with one emphasized action and actionable refusal text above the row. Next navigates without starting work; existing generation readiness remains authoritative. Refusals offer a named route to the relevant panel or existing retry. Review must read pending local values, not merely the last server project.

Boundaries: retain `/clips/new`'s explicit title/template mint and its existing offer, leave its redesign for slice 2, and enter the new preparation flow afterward. Imported clips enter the same flow with seeded material and import problems intact. Preserve the cursor across lifecycle visits within the keyed workspace; do not add cursor persistence or change artifact-derived lifecycle entry. Preserve the existing focused-job view and finalized read-only views. Defer new choice-card controls, template galleries, storyline layout, editor geometry and completion redesign.

Exact policy changes required BEFORE implementation through orchestrator update-ssot/create-task: amend CLIP-225 from four scroll destinations to four retained panels ending in 확인, specifying Back/Next, direct segment navigation, position/focus, panel lifetime and cursor scope; amend CLIP-210's 'beside the instruction' placement to advertiser context before footage on 소스 while retaining its closed counted-items disclosure and no inferred suggestions; amend CLIP-40's ① bar to the shared step bar, navigation before 확인 and separately approved generation actions on 확인, with models remaining inside ①; clarify CLIP-130 that post-mint settings occupy these panels while the explicit mint contract stays unchanged. Add a scoped review rule under CLIP-225 for latest-local-value summaries and named change routes, including narration and source-post context. Add the clip preparation guide to THEME-66/71's named instances. Update CLIP's create/steps flow text at spec/ssot/CLIP.md:447,457 accordingly. Do not change POST-122/123/124, VIDEO, generation policy, or consume unrelated pending revisions. POST-124 supports retaining relevant context here; it does not justify adding photo minimums, automatic keyword judgments or new clip gates.
proposals.preserves: Both naver_clip and instagram_clip; explicit mint, optional templates, immutable ratio and first-use offer; post-owned canonical material and videos-only import; partial-import recovery and no duplicate creation; exact instruction/answer/slot text; source order, association, original-audio choices and retention disclosure; ordinary versus narrated generation, confirmed voices and retained speech; existing style drawings and model eligibility without substitution; autosave, queue lifetimes, serialization and flush-before-commit; fresh mode/source/model-bound quotes, explicit ceilings, replacement confirmations and uncertain-start recovery; durable jobs, cancellation and leaving without cancellation; T757 unsent request retention and owner/project isolation; existing preview/playhead/selection, browser qualification and rendering, server entitlements/counts, revision-labelled downloads, explicit matching-result finalization and separately approved upload text. No backend, RPC, schema, dependency, readiness, billing, export-engine, public-contract or package-managed skill changes.
proposals.checks:
Establish the structural baseline in the real browser before editing: initial guide selection versus first visible task, source-picker position, count of simultaneously exposed preparation groups, and absence of review. Then add behavioral regressions covering direct segment navigation and Back/Next, one visible question, correct aria-current and heading focus, upload continuation while its panel is hidden, Korean/IME text and pending local values surviving navigation and delayed saves, summary change routes, template-answer retention, narration/voice readback, and owner/project boundaries. Navigation must start zero generation/speech/render operations.

Exercise empty sources, partial/unconfirmed from-post import, retained/expired originals, loading/failed model eligibility, missing voice and failed autosave. Verify each disabled generation action has an actionable explanation; a failed flush starts nothing. Preserve separate approval modes and existing quote expiry/model/source-change invalidation. Existing ClipGeneration.test.tsx:751,769,845,862 and :1050 onward protect these contracts; ClipCampaign.test.tsx:62 protects in-flight text; ClipStoryline.test.tsx:196 onward protects T757; ClipLifecycle.test.tsx:75,197 protects finalization and durable resume. Adapt tests by navigating the real UI, never by querying hidden controls or weakening assertions.

Task checks: run the new guide tests plus all changed tests and affected clip-page/workspace/edit-project regressions, EditorPage.clip-from-post.test.tsx, ClipLinkedPost.test.tsx, draft-queue, generation, storyline, lifecycle, source order/binding, composition/style, revision, preview and browser-render consumers. Use `pnpm --filter ./frontend exec vitest run <explicit selected files>` and related selection against the original task-start SHA as an aid. Reassess the complete delta; expand to the full frontend suite if shared harness effects cannot be bounded. Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm lint:fsd`, `pnpm lint:style:probe`, `pnpm lint:style`, `pnpm --filter ./frontend exec tsc -b`, `pnpm build:web` and the spec check. Record actual commands and selection rationale.

Real-browser fixture acceptance: both channels × new/from-post/resume × ordinary/narrated × 360/1440 widths, using native pointer and keyboard navigation with no forced clicks. Verify the complete preparation→review→separate fixture approval→existing storyline/editor handoff, pending-value readback, focus, one dock, source/voice/style retention and reachable render/download/finalization. Add representative delayed/error scenarios, 320 px reflow, 200% zoom, light/dark and reduced motion. Use a small playable local fixture for source/preview acceptance; the previous five-byte result fixture at frontend/src/test/mobile-route-fixture.tsx:142 cannot prove playback or rendering. Stub paid execution, inspect call logs and distinguish stubbed job completion from live qualification. Reproduce the recorded mobile pointer issue and log its result; do not silently pass an obstructed pointer path through keyboard-only traversal.

After independent review, run full ARCH-31 via docs/verification.md:19 on the final candidate: dev tests, generated-code checks, lint/FSD/retirement/style/spec, full frontend tests/build, deploy Python tests and full Go formatting/vet/build/tests. Reuse only valid unchanged-tree evidence. Inspect the entire push diff for backend/media triggers and run the documented Compose/image/three-media gates when applicable. After each actual push inspect every triggered workflow for that SHA, recording failing job/step/error rather than equating local success with deployment success.
proposals.cost: Estimate approximately 90 minutes for implementation, affected regressions, bounded browser acceptance and independent review, using existing controls rather than rebuilding them. Test adaptation is the largest uncertainty: current tests assume immediately visible inputs, for example ClipInstruction.test.tsx:45 and ClipGeneration.test.tsx:27. Keep a mid-cycle scope checkpoint; split further before exceeding the budget rather than dropping acceptance. Reserve roughly 10 minutes for full local gates and 20 minutes for remote CI, allowing expansion: the prior cycle recorded 362.06 seconds locally and 1010.252 seconds remotely (spec/reports/261112-ui12.md:31). Preserve the original deadline and at least two hours of closing reserve; this scout does not reset either.
proposals.risk: Main risks are accidentally remounting an upload/queue/approval, summarizing stale server values, hiding the only refusal/retry, triggering implicit form submission from Next, losing source-post import feedback, or increasing mobile dock obstruction. Keep presentation state separate from saved lifecycle facts, preserve original component owners, explicitly type navigation buttons, and test delayed responses. Native-pointer/header and storyline wrapping observations remain unproven at this HEAD until browser reproduction; fix only if independently scoped or required by this slice's acceptance. Rollback is a revert of the reviewed frontend slice with the corresponding SSOT/task correction; no migration or generated asset rollback is needed. Reversible workflow policy is already user-authorized, but the orchestrator must adopt the concrete policy/task before assigning implementation. This scout grants no implementation authorization and makes no measured usability, performance or live-generation claim.
